origin: Post hoc, authorized after observing source-availability imbalance in coverage_by_label.csv; not retrospectively prespecified.
trigger: WHU: 318 of 2562 patients have no accepted value in the four selected laboratories, including 102 of 281 original positives. MIMIC: 174 of 9946 admissions have no accepted value, including 60 positives.
population: At least one finite accepted laboratory in the frozen four-column matrix. Apply only to target evaluation rows, not source or local model training.
prediction_policy: Use unchanged saved full-source transfer and original five-fold local OOF probabilities for all four models. No refitting, retuning, recalibration, source exclusion, feature change or label change.
primary_analysis: The original all-2562 and all-9946 results remain primary and unchanged.

subset_intervals.scheme: Resample covered target patients with replacement, retaining every eligible admission for each selected patient; nominal percentile 95% conditional on covered population and frozen predictions.

population_difference_intervals.scheme: Shared original full-target patient-cluster multiplicities applied to full rows and coverage-restricted rows. Repeat original full-target interval calculation as a consistency check. Population contrast, not a causal coverage or transport effect.

uncertainty_limit: No source-training, model-refit, coverage-definition or selection uncertainty; no multiplicity correction.
interpretation: Coverage reflects source accessibility, successful linkage, accepted report context, explicit units and recorded finite results. It is not equivalent to a clinician not ordering tests or to disease absence. The conditional subset changes the target population and does not repair label equivalence, event timing, assay methods or source ascertainment.
